text:
maya: FYI the catchup-station queue is showing a bunch of tenants stuck in "queued" after last night's late-event surge. cost is spiking. can we gate recompute starts by SLA class? @sam can you take a look? :eyes:

sam: saw it. looks like the replayer fanout hit ~200 shards and saturated backfill slots. current behavior just starts jobs and hopes for the best. +1 on SLA gating. we also need per-tenant caps so one noisy tenant can't hog all slots.

diego: quick idea — extend the internal recompute API with explicit knobs: priority_tier and concurrency_limit, and also a target_cutoff_ts so we can avoid re-ingesting ancient duplicates. example: ```POST /internal/recompute
{
  "tenant_id": "t-123",
  "window_start": "2026-02-01T00:00:00Z",
  "window_end": "2026-02-02T00:00:00Z",
  "priority_tier": "bulk",
  "concurrency_limit": 4,
  "work_class": "aggregates-only"
}```

ops-bot: job created job_id=jb_7832 tenant=t-123 priority=bulk queued_at=1758509999

olivia: Console UX notes: show an estimated finish time computed from queue length + tenant weight, and a cost estimate before you start. also add an "abort if ETA > X" toggle so customers can opt out of huge jobs. :+1:

maya: good. also need a routing policy for capacity exhaustion — if dedicated slots are full, do we delay, route to lower-cost region, or run a degraded "aggregates-only" pass?

sam: routing should check SLA first then capacity. propose: if capacity < needed and SLA=high, reserve and wait; if SLA=low, either queue with backoff or route to "throttle" lane that only computes pre-aggregates. implement policy table: {SLA x capacity state -> action}.

diego: agree. add API-level idempotency: backfill dedupe key = [tenant, window_start, window_end, work_class]. prevents accidental duplicate runs during retries/failover.

olivia: can we feature-flag the console changes and roll them to a small set of tenants? i'll prototype mocks and toggle it for internal infra teams first.

maya: please do. @ops-bot ping when the feature flag is live. also we need telemetry: per-tenant caught-up ratio, stuck_jobs_count, and cost_burned_per_hour so SRE can detect regressions.

sam: i'll add metrics: backfill_throughput_per_min, backfill_cost_estimate, stuck_jobs_count. create alert: stuck_jobs_count > 10 for > 5m -> paging.

diego: runbook tweak: update steps for manual preempt and tenant fair-share transfer. link to add: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/recompute-notes — i'll add the dedupe/key guidance.

ops-bot: deploy ci/build-793 succeeded for recompute-service (sha: a1b2c3d) :white_check_mark:

olivia: mockups incoming tomorrow in #eng-platform, will attach screenshots and interaction notes.

maya: thanks team. next actions: diego to spec API change and idempotency, sam to add metrics/alerts, olivia to prototype UX feature flag, ops to surface flag when deployed. i'll schedule a 30m sync if any of the workblocks need face time. :calendar:

sam: one more operational note — we should cap max fanout per tenant to 32 by default with an override for customers on Dedicated. reduces blast radius.

diego: documented. will include an admin override param for dedicated customers only.

ops-bot: reminder: weekly backfills are scheduled at 03:00 UTC. next window: 2026-03-01T03:00:00Z

maya: ok closing here for now, open a PR and tag me. :thumbsup:
